dimension_evidence.diagnosis: Correct diagnosis must distinguish conversion to host from dtype-only or same-accelerator requests, account for positional and keyword overload encodings, and explain why densification must precede forwarding the requested dtype and copy semantics without recursively re-entering sparse dispatch.
dimension_evidence.localization: The public Prompt specifies conversion behavior across overload forms but names no module, dispatch table, handler, overload packet, dense conversion call, or argument parser. The solver must localize the tensor-subclass dispatch boundary and coordinate behavior across two implementation surfaces.
dimension_evidence.repair_regression: The repair spans ordinary and copy-style conversion handlers plus dispatch registration. Five fail-to-pass selectors cover positional, keyword, dtype, unsupported-target, and registration contracts, while an existing dispatch-disabled dense operation constrains recursive or global dispatcher workarounds.
